description_en: Sets the user scope for a specified control policy
description_zh: 设置指定控制策略的用户生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-user-scope --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 1 --scope-type All --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyUserScope

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy to modify.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的控制策略ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The user scope for the control policy. Valid values:

All: The policy applies to all users.
User: The policy applies to selected users.
UserGroup: The policy applies to selected user groups
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。取值：

All：策略针对所有用户生效
User：策略针对已选择的用户生效
UserGroup：策略针对已选择的用户组生效
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The user scope for the control policy.

This parameter is required when ScopeType is set to User. A maximum of 500 users can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。

当ScopeType为 User 时必填，最多500 个
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user group scope for the control policy.

This parameter is required when ScopeType is set to UserGroup. A maximum of 100 user groups can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
控制策略生效的用户组范围。

当ScopeType为 UserGroup 时必填，最多100 个
parameters.name: user_group_ids

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
